lore.bio:
Ajay Che, aka Lifeline, isn’t someone you would expect to find in the Apex Games. The child of wealthy war profiteers, she left home when she learned of the damage her family had caused and enlisted in the Frontier Corps, a humanitarian organization that aids Frontier communities in need. She’s since devoted her life to helping others and joined the Apex Games to fund the Frontier Corps with her winnings.
Since no one in the Games is innocent — they all know what they signed up for — and every one of her victories means help for those in need, Lifeline has no problem engaging in the popular bloodsport. Or so she tells herself. She may seem sarcastic and callous, but deep down she wants to help people and make the world a better place. If that means taking a few people down in the process, so be it.
But when a rift in reality swallows her loyal health drone, D.O.C., Lifeline reaches into it, sacrificing her own hand and barely managing to pull D.O.C. back to reality. Instead of crumpling under the weight of the universe, Lifeline “repairs” her damaged hand with cybernetic implants, then rebuilds D.O.C. better than ever.
Now, Lifeline’s days of getting pulled into chaotic events are over. She’ll throw herself into them headfirst, on her–and D.O.C.’s–own terms.[2]

For more information on Lifeline's story, see Lifeline (character).

passive.name: Combat Glide
passive.description: Hold Space/// mid-air to use D.O.C. to briefly glide. Deploy D.O.C to revive teammates, leaving Lifeline free to defend.

tactical.name: D.O.C. Heal Drone
tactical.description: D.O.C. heals all nearby allies at an increased rate. D.O.C. can be assigned to follow allies once deployed.

ultimate.name: D.O.C. Halo
ultimate.description: Throw D.O.C. to activate his Halo Shield System. All players inside use Health & Shield consumables faster.

tactics.playstyle: The team's guardian angel. Lifeline's positioning is crucial: she must always be the last to fall. Her revive drone allows her to pick up an ally while continuing to lay down covering fire.

left.name: Extended Flight
left.description: Increased time before D.O.C. runs out of fuel by 1.5s.

right.name: Battpack
right.description: +1 Shield Battery stack limit. Shield Battery count shown on deathbox.

left.name: Enhanced Radio
left.description: Increased distance you can assign D.O.C. by 50%.
